channel.title: RemadeByAI: new apps
channel.description: The newest AI-built apps listed on RemadeByAI: familiar software, rebuilt with AI.

item.title: Ink Flight: Inspired by relaxing flight games
item.description: Fly a folded paper plane through an explorer's sketchbook that has stood up off the page, in your browser. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Red Clay Chase: Inspired by police-chase driving games
item.description: Outrun the police in a convertible on red dirt back roads, in your browser. Five wanted levels, ramming cops and cars that come apart. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Unsung Vale: Inspired by open-world fantasy RPGs
item.description: A third-person fantasy RPG in your browser: cross a silent valley of mesas and waterfalls and wake its eight Tuning Spires. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Papertrails: Inspired by pop-up books and walking games
item.description: Walk a paper figure through an endless pop-up paper world, where trees, houses and hills fold up from the ground as you go. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Lanternfall: Inspired by idle RPG battlers
item.description: An idle battler in your browser: a party of heroes holds a lantern-lit line against waves of monsters from the dark. (Web · Free · No licence (source visible))

item.title: Little City: Inspired by Townscaper
item.description: A hand-drawn city builder in your browser: place a few blocks, watch them turn into a town, then watch people move in and live there. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Family Location: Alternative to Life360
item.description: A Life360 replacement inside Home Assistant: places, arrival and departure alerts, trips, speeding and low-battery alerts, check-in and SOS. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: zest: Alternative to Fig and Amazon Q autocomplete
item.description: An autocomplete popup for zsh on macOS: subcommands, options, files and git branches with descriptions, right under your cursor. (macOS · Free · MIT)

item.title: HomeRoll: Alternative to Apple Photos and iCloud Photos
item.description: An iPhone photos app for your own Immich server that looks and feels like Apple's Photos app, with your pictures on hardware you own. (iOS · Free · GPL-3.0)

item.title: U2C Firmware Toolkit: Alternative to 8BitDo Ultimate Software (for the Ultimate 2C)
item.description: Makes the 8BitDo Ultimate 2C Wireless show up as a native Xbox controller on a Mac, with rumble over Bluetooth, light control and live settings. (macOS, Linux · Free · GPL-3.0)

item.title: MX Options: Alternative to Logi Options+ (for Linux)
item.description: A settings app for Logitech MX Master mice on Linux: buttons, gestures, the Actions Ring, wheels, haptics and Easy-Switch. (Linux, Windows · Free · MIT)

item.title: Convert: Alternative to CloudConvert
item.description: Right-click any audio, video, image, document, PDF or font in Finder and convert it on your own Mac. Nothing is uploaded. (macOS, Windows, Linux · Free · MIT)

item.title: Brushwild: Inspired by action RPGs
item.description: An open-world action RPG drawn in ballpoint and coloured pencil, in your browser on desktop, phone or gamepad. Classes, skill tree, loot and dungeons. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Cinderwatch: Inspired by tower defense games
item.description: A 3D isometric tower defense in a single HTML file. An AI commander plays it for you; tap a tower pad to take over. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Aerial: Alternative to stock Android TV home screens
item.description: A calm, Apple TV-style home screen for Android TVs sold in China: your apps and aerial screensavers, with no ads or recommendation feeds. (Android · Free · MIT)

item.title: CUPS Admin: Replaces the CUPS web interface
item.description: A native Mac app and command-line tool that brings back the printer admin pages Apple removed from macOS 27: queues, jobs and driver options. (macOS · Free · MIT)

item.title: waarm64: Alternative to QEMU / UTM (in the browser)
item.description: A whole 64-bit ARM computer in a browser tab: boots real Linux images with 3D graphics, sound, video and USB. Nothing runs on a server. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: SimRun: Alternative to the iOS Simulator
item.description: Run iPhone apps from Xcode's Simulator builds on your Mac, each in its own ordinary window. No virtual phone to boot. (macOS · Free · MIT)

item.title: Lipflow: Alternative to Wispr Flow (silent)
item.description: Dictation without sound: hold a key, silently mouth your words, and the text appears at your cursor. Reads your lips through the webcam, locally. (macOS, Windows, Linux · Free · MIT)

item.title: NeonPlan 3D: Alternative to floor plan cards for Home Assistant
item.description: Draw your home inside Home Assistant and control it from a live 3D floor plan: lights glow, blinds move, doors open. Local, no cloud. (Web · Freemium · MIT)

item.title: Hadron: Alternative to CrossOver (for Steam games)
item.description: Play Windows games from your Steam library on Apple Silicon Macs, straight from Mac Steam. Like Proton for the Mac. Early development. (macOS · Free · BSD-2-Clause)

item.title: Folio: Alternative to Adobe Acrobat Reader
item.description: A fast, clean PDF reader for Windows, Mac and Linux: tabs, highlights and notes, signing, and optional Ask AI about your documents. No account. (Windows, macOS, Linux · Free · MIT)

item.title: Stard: Inspired by auto-battler card games
item.description: A browser card battle built from your GitHub stars: every repo you have starred is a card. Build a team and fight other developers' decks. No sign-up. (Web · Free · AGPL-3.0)

item.title: yami: Alternative to Waybar, Rofi and other desktop shell pieces
item.description: A pixel-art desktop for the niri Wayland compositor on Linux: bar, launcher, dock, notifications, lock screen, widgets and settings in one light Rust shell. (Linux · Free · MIT)

item.title: mirador: Alternative to WTF and desktop dashboard widgets
item.description: A calm personal dashboard for your terminal: clocks, calendar, weather, a real task list, notes, a market watchlist and live system graphs in one tab. (Windows, macOS, Linux · Free · MIT)

item.title: Excaliself: Alternative to Excalidraw+ and Miro
item.description: Your team's whiteboard on your own server: the Excalidraw canvas with live collaboration, a shared team space, folders and search. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Lyrimuse: Alternative to LyricsX
item.description: Desktop lyrics for the Mac: word-by-word synced lyrics for the song you are playing, in a floating overlay, the menu bar, a capsule under the notch or a lyrics window. (macOS · Free · GPL-3.0)

item.title: LibrePaper: Alternative to Overleaf and Google Docs comments
item.description: Write and review papers together in the browser: LaTeX, Typst, Markdown, Quarto, HTML or Org, with live highlights, comments and suggested edits. (Web, Windows, macOS, Linux · MIT)

item.title: Dalibre: Alternative to Calibre
item.description: A calm, fast desktop e-book library that reads and writes your existing Calibre library. One small native app, no web view. (Windows, macOS, Linux · Free · GPL-3.0)

item.title: Natel: Alternative to Google Contacts
item.description: A small web app for editing the contacts on your own CardDAV server (Baïkal, Radicale, Nextcloud and others) from any browser. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: jOtter: Alternative to Jupyter Notebook and JupyterLab
item.description: A fast Jupyter notebook app for the terminal, with vim keys, inline plots and rendered LaTeX. It opens and saves real .ipynb files. (Linux, macOS · Free · MIT or Apache-2.0)

item.title: rec-rs: Alternative to OBS Studio
item.description: A simple, fast screen and camera recorder for the Mac, made for recording YouTube videos. It records screen, system audio, microphone and webcam into one file and can stream as well. (macOS · Free · MIT or Apache-2.0)

item.title: Chipload: Alternative to Vectric VCarve and Carbide Create
item.description: Free 2.5D CAM software for CNC routers and mills: bring in a DXF or SVG drawing (or draw in the app), set up cuts, simulate them in 3D and export checked G-code. (Windows, macOS, Linux · Free · GPL-3.0)

item.title: Tungsten Edge: Alternative to uBar and the macOS Dock
item.description: A per-window taskbar for the Mac: every open window gets its own card at the bottom of the screen, one click away, the way the Windows taskbar works. (macOS · Free · GPL-3.0)

item.title: desigma: Alternative to Figma
item.description: A free, offline interface design app written in Rust, with frames, auto layout, components, prototyping and live collaboration. It opens Figma files. (Windows, macOS, Linux · Free · Apache-2.0)

item.title: Podium: Alternative to the classic iPod
item.description: An Android music player built around a click wheel, styled after classic iPods. Plays your own music library, with Cover Flow, synced lyrics and lots of finishes to choose from. (Android · Free · GPL-3.0)

item.title: Roxel: Alternative to MagicaVoxel
item.description: A lightweight desktop voxel editor for building small 3D scenes out of cubes, with import and export for MagicaVoxel, Goxel, OBJ and glTF files. (Windows, macOS, Linux · Free · MIT)

item.title: Pesto Clipboard: Alternative to Maccy and Paste
item.description: A free menu bar clipboard manager for the Mac. It keeps a searchable history of text, images and files you copy, one shortcut away. (macOS · Free · MIT)

item.title: Readfine: Alternative to Feedly and Tiny Tiny RSS
item.description: An RSS reader for the web that puts the articles you care about first, merges the same story from several sites into one row, and can summarize articles with your own AI key. (Web · Free · AGPL-3.0)

item.title: Dorso: Alternative to Upright and other posture apps
item.description: A Mac menu bar app that watches your posture through the camera or AirPods and gradually blurs the screen when you slouch. Sit up straight and the blur clears. (macOS · Free · MIT)

item.title: Calino: Alternative to Google Calendar
item.description: A calendar in your browser that connects to your own CalDAV or JMAP server, such as Nextcloud, Fastmail or Radicale. It handles events, tasks and journal notes, with no Calino account. (Web, Android · Free · MIT)

item.title: OpenWorld RPG: Inspired by open-world RPGs
item.description: A pixel-art open-world RPG in your browser with over a thousand maps, a main story, real-time combat, crafting, farming and building, plus the engine and editor it is made with. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Bokken: Inspired by physics-based sword fighting games
item.description: A 2D physics fighting game where you carve your own weapons out of pixels, and their weight, balance, edges and grip decide how they fight. (Web, Windows, Linux · Free)

item.title: The Human Box: Inspired by god games and civilization sandboxes
item.description: A civilization sandbox where Stone Age tribes invent languages, religions and wars on their own across 45 eras. Watch, or play god with blessings and disasters. (Web, Windows, macOS, Linux · Free · MIT)

item.title: Xs of Y: Inspired by roguelike games
item.description: An unfinished but playable terminal-style roguelike that names itself every run. Its magic is a small Lisp: runes stand for code, and you piece spells together. (Web, macOS, Linux · Free · MIT)

item.title: Lightkeeper: Inspired by arcade guiding games
item.description: Keep a lighthouse through seven stormy nights. Ships can only plot a course across water your beam has lit, so you sweep and hold the light to guide them past the rocks. (Web · Free)

item.title: Coalheart: Inspired by turn-based puzzle games
item.description: A short turn-based puzzle game in your browser: a little coal creature carries the last fire through a cold temple, and the order you collect and spend that fire is the puzzle. (Web · Free)

item.title: Kara and the Primal Torch: Inspired by retro action platformers
item.description: A pixel-art side-scrolling platformer in your browser. A living torch floats beside the heroine and homes in on enemies, but every blast dims the only light you have. (Web · Free)

item.title: Torched!: Inspired by cooking games
item.description: A short browser cooking game set in a tiny Paris bistro: sweep a kitchen torch over desserts and fish until they turn gold, not black, while a feared food critic watches. (Web · Free)

item.title: Minute: Alternative to Granola, Otter.ai
item.description: A Mac meeting note-taker that works with no internet at all. It notices when a call starts, transcribes it live, then writes a summary, decisions and action items with a local model. (macOS · Free · MIT)
